messages.subject: Errors in replication of rChartsNYT
parts:
Greetings - I'm working through the rCharts NYT example from Ramnath Vaidyanathan and have run into a few different errors I'm hoping someone might be able to assist me with. I'm fairly new to using R in this way, so any basic pointers would be great. When evaluating this site http://ramnathv.github.io/rChartsNYT/ I'm able to get to the part of:

graph_chart3.addHandler (type, e) ->
  data = e.evtData
  if type == 'click'
    alert "You clicked on the team: " + data.name.in[0]

When this is run I receive errors of 
Error: object 'e.evtData' not found
Error: unexpected symbol in "  if type"
Error: unexpected string constant in " alert  "You clicked on the team: " "

Further, on the #ui.R portion of the code I receive an error of:

Error in dependsOnFile(path) : 
  addFileDependency was called at an unexpected time (no cache context found)

Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Thank you.
